description.value:
Unlike ordinary matter, the magical substance that makes up your pawns can flow freely across short distances, letting them enhance one another's power. This Ethereal Pawn gains a circumstance bonus to damage with its Strikes equal to the number of attack-form Ethereal Pawns adjacent to it, and a circumstance bonus to AC equal to the number of defense-form Ethereal Pawns adjacent to it.

Counting adjacent pawns by form isn't automated yet (a DESIGN.md §5 M8 stretch goal); the GM and players track and apply these bonuses by hand for now.
